gallery.filename: Flickr - The U.S. Army - Vietnam smoke bomb.jpg
gallery.title: File:Flickr - The U.S. Army - Vietnam smoke bomb.jpg
gallery.description:
Companies B and C, 1st Bn, 8th Inf, 1st Bde, 4th Inf Div, assemble on top of Hill 742, located five miles northeast of Dak To, prior to moving out.  A purple smoke bomb is ignited in the background to guide in a helicopter.

November 14-17, 1967

gallery.filename: B-52 bomb craters near Dak To 1967.jpg
gallery.title: File:B-52 bomb craters near Dak To 1967.jpg
gallery.description: Jungle of Dak Ta Kan valley after a U.S. Air Force Boeing B-52 bomber raid near Dak To, Vietnam. B-52s flew 257 strikes in support of the Battle of Dak To (Operation MacArthur), 3–22 November 1967.

gallery.description:
From Joel D. Meyerson, Images of a Lengthy War. Washington DC: US Army Center of Military History, 1986.
This photo looks like it is of Mahlon S Jenkins, A/1/503d - 173rd Airborne Brigade, and was taken during the battle of Dak To on Hill 882 (1967).
